== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[E-web Blaster (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[E-web Blaster (PC Errata 2021 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018). The whole 2021 E image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>eaca3568cd577035dd13816729adf367f2f67b3a</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
